title: Locations
wikitext:
{{construction}} Stardew Valley Expanded adds 18 new locations along with making changes to the base game maps. Locations have been separated out by wider areas, and then listed within each area are the additions and changes Stardew Valley Expanded makes. Significant or noticeable changes have been made to the following vanilla locations: * Pelican Town * The Mountain * The Railroad * Cindersap Forest {{TOC|align=right}} == Pelican Town == {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Pelican Town_SVE.png|thumb|alt=Pelican Town in Expanded]] |[[Pelican Town]] |Additions:
  • [[Jenkins' Residence]] - home of [[Olivia]] and [[Victor]]

Aesthetic map changes are made to:
  • The area around the Community Center.
  • The area around JojaMart, including where the Bookseller sets up shop and the land south of JojaMart.
  • The area south of the Museum, which includes a small community garden.
  • The path to the Beach is split into two; the path on the west side leads to Blue Moon Vineyard
|} [[Category:Locations]] ===West of Pelican Town=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Blue_Moon_Vineyard.png|250px|center]] |[[Blue Moon Vineyard]] |A new area added between The Beach and Cindersap Forest.
Residence of [[Sophia]], Blue Moon Vineyard is accessible via the west path forked from the main Beach path in Pelican Town, via the path on the eastern side of The Beach, or by heading east from the southeastern quadrant of Cindersap Forest. |} ===East of Pelican Town=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Old_Community_Garden.png|300px|center]] |[[Old Community Garden]] |A new area added east of the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]]. Connects to [[Shearwater Bridge]]. |- |[[File:Shearwater_Bridge.png|300px|center]] |[[Shearwater Bridge]] |A new area added east of [[Stardew:Blacksmith|Clint's Blacksmith]]. Traveling east connects to [[Grampleton Fields]]. The southern path connects to the [[Old Community Garden]]. For players who also install the [[wgg:EastScarp:EastScarp|East Scarp]] expansion mod, the eastern exit will lead to East Scarp's main village. |- |[[File:Grampleton_Fields.png|250px|center]] |[[Grampleton Fields]] |An expansive, optional map that can only be used by the player. Accessible via the eastern exit from [[Shearwater Bridge]], the train station at the Railroad, and via warp rune in the Wizard's Tower. |- |[[File:Morris Property.png|300px|center]] |[[Morris Property]] |Only accessible to players who chose the Joja route over the community center route, the Morris property is where Morris lives after making the choice to move to Pelican Town permanently. It's accessible via a small path east of JojaMart or by heading north on the western side of [[Shearwater Bridge]]. |} ==Backwoods== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Enchanted Grove.png|300px|center]] |[[Enchanted Grove]] |Accessible by warping or through a path in [[Stardew:Backwoods|Backwoods]], Enchanted Grove is home to the Nexus, a ring of specific warp points to new locations that players can unlock. |- |} == The Mountain == {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Adventurer Summit.png|300px|center]] |[[Adventurer Summit]] |Located north of the Mountain Lake, The Adventurer Summit is the new location of the [[Stardew:Adventurer's Guild|Adventurer's Guild]] and the relocated mine entrance. To the east, a boat can be used to travel to [[the Highlands]]. The Adventurer Summit also connects to the Railroad via a path in the northwest. |} ===The Railroad=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Descripion |- |[[File:Emerald_Farm.png|300px|center]] |[[Emerald Farm]] |Emerald Farm is located beside the Spa and Train Platform. It is home to [[Susan]] and is only accessible after the landslide is cleared in summer, opening the entrance to the Railroad. |- |[[File:Forbidden Maze.png|300px|center]] |[[Forbidden Maze]] |Accessed by the warp inside the cave northeast of the Train Platform, passage through this area is needed to get to the Witch's Swamp. It is only available after finishing the Community Center or Joja Warehouse and completing the Dark Talisman Quest. |- |[[File:Summit.png|300px|center]] |[[The Summit]] |Located up the mountain to the north of the Railroad, The Summit is home to exclusive foragables. Access to the Summit is only available by completing a quest from [[Stardew:Clint|Clint]] to remove a boulder blocking the path. |} ==Cindersap Forest== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Cindersap Forest.png|400px|center]] |[[Cindersap Forest]] | Additions:
  • [[Fairhaven Farm]] - Andy's farm and residence

Aesthetic changes are made to:
  • Marnie's Ranch - additional outbuildings; a small fenced-in crop area to the west
  • The area around Leah's cottage, including a new bridge across the river to reach the southeastern part of the forest
  • A new pathway east, leading to Blue Moon Vineyard
  • The area around the Wizard's Tower
  • The area south and west of The Hat Mouse
|} ===Secret Woods=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Secret Woods.png|300px|center]] |[[Secret Woods]] |The Secret Woods has been fully re-imagined and expanded upon, with more hardwood stumps, monsters, forage, and a navigable maze to reach [[Stardew:Old Master Cannoli|Old Master Cannoli's statue]]. Two new access points were also added: northwest, to the Farm, and south of the lake, to [[Forest West]]. |} ===Forest West=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Forest West.png|300px|center]] |[[Forest West]] |An expansive new area added west of Cindersap Forest. It also connects in the north to the Secret Woods. Forest West contains a large amount of forageables and trees, plus a small river in the southwestern most corner.
Points of interest include:
  • [[Aurora Vineyard]]
  • [[Bear|Bear's]] home & shop
  • [[Sprite Spring]]
    • |- |[[File:Sprite Spring.png|300px|center]] |[[Sprite Spring]] |A new area accessible via a wooded path in the southeastern quadrant of Forest West or via the nexus warp in [[Enchanted Grove]]. |} ==Grampleton Suburbs== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Grampleton Suburbs.png|300px|center]] |[[Grampleton Suburbs]] | |} ==Galdoran Continent== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Castle Village Outpost.png|300px|center]] |[[Castle Village Outpost]] | |- |[[File:Desert Railway.png|300px|center]] |[[Castle Village Outpost|Desert Railway]] | |- |[[File:Crimson Badlands.png|300px|center]] |[[Crimson Badlands]] | |- |[[File:Treasure Cave.png|300px|center]] |[[Crimson Badlands|Treasure Cave]] | |- |[[File:Iridium Quarry.png|300px|center]] |[[Iridium Quarry]] | |- |} ==Highlands== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:The Highlands.png|300px|center]] |[[The Highlands]] | |- |[[File:Highlands Outpost.png|300px|center]] |[[Highlands Outpost]] | |- |[[File:Highlands Ruins.png|300px|center]] |[[The Highlands|Highlands Ruins]] | |- |[[File:Bully Rex's Summit.png|300px|center]] |[[The Highlands|Bully Rex's Summit]] | |- |[[File:Crystal Cavern.png|300px|center]] |[[Crystal Cavern]] | |- |[[File:Diamond Cavern.png|300px|center]] |[[Diamond Cavern]] | |} ==Fable Reef== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description |- |[[File:Fable Reef.png|300px|center]] |[[Fable Reef]] | |} {{Navbox Locations}} Note that some information has been taken from https://stardew-valley-expanded.fandom.com/wiki/Stardew_Valley_Expanded_Wiki, please see edits for further information.
